title: override catches the bug
prompt: Implement `class Sensor` with `virtual std::string reading() const` returning `"base"`, and `class TempSensor : public Sensor` overriding it to return `"22C"`. The signature must match exactly (const included) and the override must use the `override` keyword.

tests.name: dispatch
tests.hint: Dispatch through base pointer returns the override.
